idea-plugin.name: Mail View
idea-plugin.description:
Read .eml, Outlook .msg/.oft, Apple Mail .emlx and .mht web archives like in a mail client, right in your IDE - read-only, so your mails stay untouched. Mail View shows subject, sender, recipients, the rendered message and attachments instead of encoded MIME text.

Views, switchable at the bottom of the editor

  • Mail (default): subject, from, to, CC, BCC, reply-to and date, followed by the rendered message. Embedded images are shown, remote content is blocked until you allow it. Attachments can be opened or saved.
  • Content: the decoded HTML or plain text part, with syntax highlighting.
  • Headers: SPF/DKIM/DMARC results and the delivery path with the delay of each hop, followed by all header lines.
  • Text: the raw file, read-only by default so a mail can't be changed by accident. Edit in the bar above unlocks it; changes show up in the other views right away. (not for .msg/.oft, they are a binary format.)

Links in a message open in your system browser. Scripts never run.

Works in all JetBrains IDEs based on the IntelliJ Platform (PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, ...). UI available in English and German.

Like Mail View? You can support it via GitHub Sponsors or buy me a coffee on Ko-fi. More tools at heckit.app.
